text.p: -- Cowen and Co said it upgraded Warner-Lambert Co to strong buy from buy, citing a U.S. joint venture deal with Sankyo Co Ltd.
-- Analyst Ian Sanderson said the deal, announced Tuesday, will give Warner-Lambert the sales "bandwidth" to boost its trogiltazone diabetes drug to the $500 million-a-year level.
-- He raised his sales estimates for the drug, which is pending U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval, to $550 from $450 million in the year 2000.
-- To adjust for the deal, Cowen raised earnings estimates on Warner-Lambert to $3.07 from $3.05 for 1997, to $3.55 from $3.50 in 1998, to $4.00 from $3.95 for 1999 and to $4.55 from $4.45 in 2000.
